title: A Noetherian local algebra over a field, formally smooth for its maximal-ideal-adic topology, is geometrically regular
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $(C,\mathfrak m)$ a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $k\to C$ a ring homomorphism, making $C$ a $k$-algebra. If $C$ is formally smooth over $k$ for the $\mathfrak m$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then $C$ is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]: for every finite purely inseparable field extension $k'/k$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] the ring $k'\otimes_kC$ [def-weil-module-base-change] is a regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: More on Algebra, Theorem Tag 07EL (theorem-regular-fs, line 9872), implication (2) => (1) in both characteristics, and its proof (lines 9897-9910): in characteristic p > 0 by Lemma Tag 07EG (lemma-base-change-fs) and Lemma Tag 07EI (lemma-fs-implies-regular, line 9535); in characteristic 0 by Lemma 07EI alone (then k' = k)
